# Project Git & Contribution Rules

Every time code changes are to be committed and pushed in this repository:
1. Always work, commit, and push all changes to the branch: **`chimataraghuram-dev`** first.
2. In the commit message, include proper GitHub co-author trailers separated by a blank line with the valid numeric ID email format so all contributors are credited and it counts toward the Pair Extraordinaire badge:

```
Co-authored-by: bchakradharreddy <196437314+bchakradharreddy@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Ramesh7075 <196447105+Ramesh7075@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: shalemshalem250-bot <305574392+shalemshalem250-bot@users.noreply.github.com>
```

3. **Branch Sync & Merge Rule**:
   - After pushing to `chimataraghuram-dev`, merge `chimataraghuram-dev` into `main` and push to `origin/main`.
   - Ensure both branches remain cleanly synced.
